audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 3 and 4 are labelled Skill in both layers while their whys say 'You own L1', 'Through 4-5 you win extended trades' and 'at 6 you stay ahead'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Yone on all seven rows and every why agrees. Three rows were showing a token that contradicted the sentence printed under it.
audit.corrected: Set rows 0, 3 and 4 to Yone in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns, and the level-6 spike is dismissed as 'a roam/save tool'.
audit.why: Abyssal Dive is 21/20/19/18/17s — that is the number the whole lane plan is built on and it is nowhere on the page. Tongue Lash is 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s. The level-6 spike is not about roaming: An Acquired Taste reaching three stacks is what lets him stun with Tongue Lash and use Devour, and that happens whenever he lands three hits, not on a timer.
audit.corrected: Write Abyssal Dive at 21s rank 1, and tie the level-6 row to An Acquired Taste stacks rather than to a roam timer.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page names 'Abyssal Voyage' twice as his ultimate, calls Devour his W, and attributes his grey-health sustain to his passive.
audit.why: Abyssal Voyage is not in this kit at all. His slots are Q Tongue Lash, W Abyssal Dive, E Thick Skin, R Devour. The sustain is Thick Skin (E): 'Tahm Kench stores a percent of the damage he takes and heals based on it while out of combat. Active: Convert all stored damage into a temporary shield' — the heal is gated on him leaving combat, which is the actionable half and the page never says it. His passive is An Acquired Taste, and at three stacks Tongue Lash stuns instead of slowing and Devour becomes available. Abyssal Dive is a knockup, so it and Mortal Steel's two-stack knockup are competing displacements — whoever lands first owns the trade.
audit.corrected: R is Devour, W is Abyssal Dive, and the sustain is Thick Skin, which only pays out as healing once he is out of combat — so stay on him. Three An Acquired Taste stacks turn his next Tongue Lash into a stun.

audit.why: Executioner's Calling early is right — Tongue Lash heals him on champion hit and Thick Skin heals off stored damage, and missingInteractions flags both.

notes: Fabricated/outdated ability name found twice: 'Abyssal Voyage' is named as Tahm Kench's ultimate in spikes[1].text and wants.foe[2]. It is not in the kit — his R is Devour, and Devour was in turn mislabelled as his W in spikes[3].text. Neither error is a misspelling, so the packet's name-distance check could not see them (defects and suspectNames were both empty), which is the same blind spot the mirror agent reported from the other side. Third correction: the page credits his sustain to a 'gray-health passive'. The passive is An Acquired Taste (a stun/Devour enabler); the sustain is Thick Skin (E), and it only heals while he is OUT of combat — the single most actionable fact in this matchup and it was absent.
